title: Overlap: the feature is already merged

checks.name: the ledger records the overlap, naming #7 and its commit
the owner is told about #7
checks.detail: the chat or a question names #7

reasons: The harness found PR #7 and correctly identified the gap: «Remover credencial» calls DELETE /configs/:key and deletes the whole row, label and settings with it.
It never stopped to ask the owner or propose a follow-up. It went straight on to the implement step, and told the owner only after that step was already running.

The scope it kept rebuilds things #7 already covers: a new PUT /configs/:key/credential endpoint and a dedicated replace dialog. Replace already works through the existing upsert, so neither is needed.
It never told the owner that the endpoints in the brief are unneeded for replace. The plan report says 'Sem questões em aberto' (no open questions).
What it said about #7 is accurate: the buttons, the accounts link with the form gone, and the delete-the-whole-row bug. It made no false claims.
